# HSD inference components

This directory contains the GSM8K evaluator and Transformers components used by ADSD inference.

Source: [Hierarchical Speculative Decoding](https://github.com/ZhouYuxuanYX/Hierarchical-Speculative-Decoding), commit `b8575e2ad42bcf2b32d0c6f3481eb49099453f33`.

Use the [ADSD installation and inference instructions](../../README.md) to run this project. The runtime applies the adaptations in `scripts/eval/internal/prepare_workspace.py`.

License: [Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Upstream copyright headers are retained in the source files.
